# uup_project (Data Source)

Looks up a Project by its `id` or its `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uup_project" "main" {
  name = "My project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Project's identifier, `prj_…`.
- `name` (String) The Project's name.

### Read-Only

- `default_location_count` (Number) How many locations a new Monitor is checked from when it names none.
- `timezone` (String) The IANA timezone its days are cut by.
